usedFor: Adafruit IO holds feeds, and Google Docs gets text from “New Feed Data” via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new reading lands in a document tab your team can read without opening the feed.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so choose add when you want a running log.
